I popped in the server today, looks like it's getting some kind of population--glad to see it. I noticed it's 100% vanilla though--which is great, but I have a couple suggestions.

1) Use craftbukkit (not spigot) to be able to use bukkit plugins. With that, use... a) [EssentialsX](http://dev.bukkit.org/bukkit-plugins/essentialsx/) is a fork of the original [Essentials](http://dev.bukkit.org/bukkit-plugins/essentials/) to support newer craftbukkit/spigot versions. Not all features need be used, but the big ones are user-to-user teleport, homes, and basic world protection. You can use economy if you want, I'd suggest [ChestShop](http://dev.bukkit.org/bukkit-plugins/chestshop/) to go with it. b) [GriefPrevention](http://dev.bukkit.org/bukkit-plugins/grief-prevention/) allows you to make claims to keep people from griefing builds and stealing stuff.

There's a TON of plugins out there, but I feel these two are absolutely essential. There's other plugins that do the same things of course, but I can vouch for these. I was talking to @Alduin in the server about this stuff, he told me to make a post to see what y'all think.

My pedigree: I ran /v/WerdCraft when it existed for like... 6 months. If nothing else, the server was stable and smooth once I moved to a host that had proper DDoS protection. I used a ton more plugins, though.

Why are you suggesting not using spigot? Bukkit plugins work fine on spigot.

I am going to second grief prevention. It is very handy and easy to use.

You're right that bukkit plugins work fine on spigot, but the problem is mob spawning. There's a common issue where mobs either become rare or stop spawning all together, I've seen it happen on two servers. I had control of the second one, mob spawning returned to normal under craftbukkit. It's not actively developed anymore by itself, but the spigot team builds and releases it with spigot. I don't know if they've done it past 1.8.8 at this point, that's the last time I was active.

EDIT: It's still available in updated versions at Yive's mirror, here: https://tcpr.ca/downloads/craftbukkit

Interesting. I had this happen on the server i administrated which was running on spigot. We made use of a lot of other spigot features iirc though, so I'm not sure that shifting to bukkit would be ideal.
Spigot is great if you've got a big server, you really can't live without it. But for up to like 30 players or less? Craftbukkit is great.
